info.title: Pass the World API
info.description: Backend for Pass the World: players take turns with one shared Terraria world and character. Used by the website and the tModLoader mod. Times are Unix epoch milliseconds.

tags.name: Mod linking
tags.description: Linking the tModLoader mod to an account with a short code.

bearerAuth.description: A session token. The website gets one from Discord sign-in; the mod gets one through the /device link flow.

userCode.description: What the player types on the site.

verifyUrl.description: Site page with the code pre-filled.

OrderMode.description: strict: fixed rotation. open: anyone except whoever played last.

userIds.description: Every player exactly once, first player first.

get.description: For load balancers and the Docker healthcheck.
Opened by the browser, not fetched. Sets a short-lived state cookie and redirects to Discord's consent screen.
Where Discord sends the browser after consent (verified with the state cookie). Creates the user on first sign-in, then redirects to the site at `#/auth?token=…` with a new web session token.

302.description: Redirect to the site with a session token in the URL fragment.

post.description: The mod calls this every `intervalSeconds`; the `deviceCode` is the credential. Returns `pending` until the player approves, then hands out a long-lived mod token exactly once.

patch.description: Only the fields sent are changed. Status can go running ↔ paused, or to finished. Finishing closes the open turn (an active one keeps its last checkpoint) and posts to Discord. Unpausing restarts the waiting player's start window. Changing `orderMode` re-picks who the waiting turn belongs to. World and character names can only change during setup.

post.description: Starts a waiting turn, or resumes your own active one (after a crash, quit or PC switch). Requires a player in the rotation and a running game. Strict order: only the turn's owner can claim. Open order: anyone except whoever played last. Claiming starts the wall clock; resuming doesn't pause or reset it.
